run_throw_on_failure_test: run the googletest throw-on-failure test suite with gtest_test_utils.Main() to verify exit codes
test_throw_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable by setting it to 0 or 1 and verifying exit behavior
test_throw_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_throw_on_failure CLI flag by passing 0 or 1 and verifying assertion failure exit codes
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_throw_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable
run_and_verify_exit_code: run the throw-on-failure test binary with given env var and flag values and verify expected failure
